sql:
WITH seller_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        AVG(CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) as avg_packing_time
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_review_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        AVG(orr.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews orr ON o.order_id = orr.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id
),
seller_with_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.seller_id,
        ss.total_quantity,
        ss.avg_item_price,
        ss.avg_packing_time,
        AVG(srs.avg_review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM seller_stats ss
    JOIN seller_review_stats srs ON ss.seller_id = (
        SELECT seller_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id = srs.order_id LIMIT 1
    )
    GROUP BY ss.seller_id, ss.total_quantity, ss.avg_item_price, ss.avg_packing_time
)
